# hpe_morpheus_virtual_image (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Virtual Image resource.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image_type` (String) Code of image type (e.g. vmdk, qcow2, raw, vmware).
- `name` (String) The name of the virtual image.

### Optional

- `install_agent` (Boolean) Whether to install the agent.
- `is_cloud_init` (Boolean) Whether Cloud Init is enabled.
- `labels` (List of String) Labels for the virtual image.
- `min_disk` (Number) Minimum disk in bytes.
- `min_ram` (Number) Minimum RAM in bytes.
- `os_type_id` (Number) The ID of the OS type.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the virtual image.
